comment: Evaluates the ABAC grants as one more allow beside the policies of the ACRs, so a policy denying a mode overrides them.
Being part of ACP's verdict, they create and delete only through the parent container, and never reach an ACR, as they cannot grant Control.

@graph.comment: Determines which modes the ABAC rules grant, from the attributes of the requesting agent, the target resource and the request itself.

comment: Values the attributes describing the request itself.
Override this instance to set the business hours and the internal networks of a deployment.

loader.comment: Reads the ABAC store directly through the ResourceStore, bypassing authorization.

comment: Routes requests on the ABAC store to the reader that guards it.
The store's location is also set on the loader and the store reader, and covered by the excluded paths: move all of them together, or the store is left unguarded.

PathBasedReader:_paths_value.comment: Only the ABAC administrator may write the store, while anyone may read its definitions and rules. Returns explicit `false`.
